requirements.text: The screen title appears exactly once and only in the header of the Add receipt screen.
The date picker icon is positioned inside the Date field on the Add receipt screen.
There are no empty gaps larger than the standard spacing between fields on the Add receipt screen.
The "Scan receipt" button is not shown when scanning functionality is not available.
All existing features, tests, and screens must remain functional after cleaning up the Add receipt screen.
